text:
Type: stepped storage unit with bins
Use: sorting toys, crafts and small items in pull-out bins; children's room, playroom, living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: white painted board frame, white plastic storage boxes on side runners
Colors: white, bright white bins
Shape: three columns of rising height forming a staircase silhouette, open frame holding six deep slide-out boxes, flat tops for display, low and friendly, medium visual weight
Feel: playful, tidy, practical, bright
Goes with: light wood floors, pastel or colorful accents, white walls; Scandinavian kids' rooms and family living rooms

product.name: TROFAST
product.description: A playful and sturdy storage series for storing and organising toys, sitting, playing and relaxing.
